item.title: Bilingual WordPress Skeleton Build
item.description:
250-750 USD | I want a clean WordPress installation that already handles two languages out of the box and gives me a solid foundation to extend later. You will set up the CMS on my hosting, configure a reputable multilingual plugin (WPML, Polylang, or similar) and leave dummy content blocks in both languages so I can swap the text myself.
On top of that, I need the essentials of on-page SEO in place—permalink structure, meta-tag control, XML sitemap, and an SEO plugin such as Yoast or RankMath already tuned with best-practice defaults. Speed plugins and security hardening are welcome but please keep everything lightweight; this site is meant to grow, not to feel bloated.
Interactive elements should be ready to activate. At minimum I expect a working contact form module and placeholders for extra widgets like live chat or polls, disabled by default until I add my own API keys. Give me clear instructions inside the admin area or a short PDF so I know where to switch them on.
Deliverables • WordPress installed and secured on my server • Multilingual framework active with example pages in both languages • Home, About, and Services pages pre-built with placeholder text and Gutenberg blocks • Basic SEO plugin configured and XML sitemap generated • Contact form tested and functioning • Written hand-off notes (1-2 pages) explaining how to change text, duplicate pages in the second language, and enable any interactive widgets
The site must be responsive, pass Google’s Mobile-Friendly test, and load in under three seconds on a standard connection. Once the skeleton is running smoothly, I’ll take over content and design tweaks myself.

item.title: Full-Stack Web3 Dev for Gaming Marketplace
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | Project Overview
We are building MarketHub, a blockchain-powered Web3 marketplace where users can discover, buy, sell, trade, and manage digital gaming assets using cryptocurrency and Web3 wallets. The platform combines Web3 marketplace functionality, blockchain transactions, digital asset licensing, AI integration, and user account management. We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Web3 Developer to review, improve, and continue developing the existing MarketHub platform.
Key Responsibilities - Review and understand the existing MarketHub codebase and architecture. - Develop and improve the Web3 marketplace frontend and backend. - Implement and maintain Web3 wallet connectivity. - Integrate blockchain transactions into marketplace workflows. - Develop and improve smart-contract functionality using Solidity and OpenZeppelin. - Implement buying, selling, listing, trading, and digital-asset licensing workflows. - Support secondary marketplace functionality. - Integrate cryptocurrency/token-based payments. - Improve transaction status handling and blockchain confirmation flows. - Work with MongoDB for marketplace and user-related data. - Integrate AI-powered functionality into the marketplace. - Improve frontend performance, responsiveness, and user experience. - Identify technical issues, security risks, and areas for architectural improvement. - Test marketplace workflows across frontend, backend, and blockchain components. - Collaborate on future features and technical improvements.
Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone with proven experience in: - Full-stack Web3 development - React / Next.js / TypeScript - Node.js backend development - Solidity smart contracts - Ethereum / EVM-compatible networks - OpenZeppelin - Web3 wallet integration - Token-based transactions - NFT or digital-asset marketplaces - MongoDB - REST APIs and backend architecture - Blockchain transaction management
Experience with gaming, GameFi, NFT marketplaces, DeFi, or AI + Web3 platforms is a strong advantage.
What We Expect
The selected developer should be comfortable working with an existing codebase rather than starting everything from scratch. The initial phase will focus on: - Reviewing the existing MarketHub platform. - Understanding the current architecture and workflows. - Identifying technical gaps and potential issues. - Reviewing Web3 and blockchain integration. - Evaluating marketplace functionality. - Recommending improvements. - Implementing agreed-upon improvements and features.
Deliverables
- Improved and maintainable MarketHub codebase - Functional Web3 wallet integration - Reliable blockchain transaction workflows - Marketplace buy/sell/listing functionality - Digital asset licensing functionality - Secondary marketplace functionality - AI integration improvements - Improved frontend UX and performance - Proper error and loading-state handling - Secure and well-structured smart-contract integration - Technical documentation where appropriate
How to Apply
Please include: - A brief introduction - Your experience with Web3 marketplace development - Relevant React/Next.js + Node.js projects - Solidity / smart-contract experience - Examples of Web3, NFT, GameFi, or blockchain projects - GitHub or portfolio links - Your availability - Your hourly rate or project-based expectations
Please also briefly describe one Web3 project you have developed or significantly contributed to, including your specific responsibilities.

item.title: Environmental Admin & Payroll Coordinator
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | I run a San Francisco–based habitat-restoration company and need an organised, tech-savvy hand for about 20 hours each week. The heartbeat of the job is keeping our timecards and payroll straight: you’ll pull field hours from QuickBooks, push them into ADP, cross-check labour-compliance data in LCP Tracker, and flag discrepancies before they reach the crew.
Around that core responsibility, you’ll keep our many small but critical wheels turning—renewing insurance certificates on schedule, tracking the status of several concurrent contracts, ordering safety gear and native-plant supplies, and touching base with a wide range of clients that includes municipal and state agencies. Clear, confident email and phone communication is a must.
Our website needs only light care right now; I’ll count on you to log in once or twice a week and refresh content such as new project photos, volunteer-day announcements, or blog posts. If you happen to shoot and edit short videos, great—we can finally give our social channels some love.
We’ll meet in person in the city most weeks to hash out proposals, swap paperwork, and plan upcoming field work, so being Bay-Area local is important.
Key deliverables • Weekly ADP payroll submitted with reconciled QuickBooks hours • Up-to-date LCP Tracker records for each active contract • Current insurance, licences, and vendor accounts on file • Fresh web content posted by Friday each week
Tools in play: ADP Workforce Now, QuickBooks Online, Google Workspace, LCP Tracker, and WordPress. If those are already second nature—or you’re a fast learner who loves the outdoors—let’s talk.

I’ll measure success through better PageSpeed Insights scores, noticeable ranking lifts for priority local keywords, and an uptick in calls or visits from nearby customers. item.title: ZIORE – Premium Sleepwear Shopify Website Design & Development
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I’m currently developing ZIORE, a new Australian premium sleepwear and lifestyle brand, and I’m looking for an experienced Shopify designer/developer to help create our website ready for launch.
ZIORE is centred around comfort, slowing down and making everyday downtime feel a little more special. Our tagline is “Made to slow down.”
We will initially be launching with a small collection of approximately 3 sleepwear sets (2 women’s and 1 men’s), with plans to expand into loungewear, track pants, blankets, robes and other comfort/lifestyle products in the future.
I already have the brand identity and product development underway, including logo, colour palette and overall visual direction. I’m looking for someone who can take this direction and translate it into a beautiful, functional and professional Shopify store.
THE LOOK & FEEL
I want the website to feel premium, warm, calm, modern and slightly moody.
Think elevated and editorial, but still comfortable, cozy and welcoming. Minimal without being plain or boring.
The brand uses muted colours such as dusty plum, slate/midnight blue, warm cream/oat, chocolate and soft neutrals.
I do not want a generic dropshipping-style Shopify website or simply a standard template with my logo and products added. Design and brand presentation are very important to me.
I'd love thoughtful details, subtle movement/animations and beautiful use of photography and typography while keeping the website clean, fast and easy to shop.
WEBSITE REQUIREMENTS
The initial website will likely include:
- Homepage - Shop / collection pages - Individual product pages - About ZIORE - Contact - FAQ - Size guide - Shipping & returns - Standard policy pages - Newsletter/email signup - Reviews - Product recommendations - Size and colour variants - Social media integration - Cart and checkout setup - Payment/shipping setup - Basic SEO - Mobile optimisation
The website needs to be fully responsive and particularly strong on mobile.
I would also like the backend to be easy enough for me to manage myself after handover, including adding products, changing photos/text and creating future collections.
HOMEPAGE
I'd like the homepage to sell the feeling of ZIORE, not just display products.
I'd love a strong hero section introducing ZIORE – Made to slow down, followed by a mixture of collection/product imagery, brand storytelling, fabric/comfort details, close-up product details and lifestyle imagery.
The aim is for customers to understand the thought that has gone into the fabric, fit, details and overall experience rather than seeing the products as simply another pair of pyjamas.
CURRENT STAGE
The products are currently still being finalised, so professional campaign/product photography is not available yet.
I'd like to create the website structure and overall design first, with the ability to easily replace temporary images and content with final photography before launch.
I'm happy to work collaboratively and would actually love someone who can contribute ideas and suggest improvements rather than simply following instructions.
WHO I'M LOOKING FOR
Ideally, you have experience designing Shopify websites for fashion, lifestyle, sleepwear or premium ecommerce brands and have a strong eye for branding and visual design as well as the technical side of Shopify.
When applying, please send examples of relevant Shopify/ecommerce websites you personally worked on.
Please also let me know:
Your proposed approach Estimated timeframe What is included in your quote Recommended Shopify theme and any additional theme cost Any paid apps/plugins you recommend and their ongoing costs Number of revisions included Whether you provide assistance/support after launch Whether basic SEO and Shopify setup are included Whether I will have full ownership/admin access to the completed website
I'm a small new Australian business, so budget is important, but I'm looking for good value and the right person rather than simply the cheapest option. I'd also love to find someone I can continue working with as ZIORE grows. identity, logo, colour palette and overall art direction, is already in the works, so your mission is to translate that look and feel into an intuitive, conversion-friendly site that celebrates comfort and slowing down.
Scope of work • Build the Shopify theme so the entire site feels cozy and inviting, matching the brand’s “Made to slow down” spirit. • Upload and merchandise a tight launch range of three sleepwear sets (two women’s, one men’s) with the flexibility to add future loungewear, blankets and lifestyle items. • Configure navigation, product pages, cart and checkout to keep the buying journey simple and stress-free.
Homepage requirements 1. Full-screen hero image that instantly sets the mood. 2. Featured product sections to spotlight the launch sets. 3. Customer testimonials to reinforce trust and comfort.
I’ll provide high-resolution product photography, copy, exact brand colours, fonts and logo files. You’ll provide: a finished, live Shopify store ready for launch, plus any theme customisations or apps required to achieve the experience above.
If you love pairing thoughtful design with seamless e-commerce functionality, I’d love to see your portfolio and discuss timelines.
Look forward to speaking and collaborating with you!

item.title: Full-Stack Next.js Developer For Chauffeur Website Overhaul
item.description:
250-750 USD | We are seeking an experienced Full-Stack Next.js Developer to rebuild, modernize, and deploy our luxury private transportation and chauffeur website.
The goal is to replace a legacy WordPress installation with a fast, high-performance web application built using Next.js (App Router) and Tailwind CSS, paired with a lightweight admin CMS/dashboard for content and reservation leads, delivered fully deployed on our Linux VPS.
Scope of Work & Deliverables 1. Public High-End Website Architecture: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Pages & Flow: Replicate and elevate existing site design across core pages: Home, Fleet, Services, About Us, and Booking/Inquiry.
Fleet Showcase: Dynamic vehicle catalog with specs (passenger limits, luggage capacity, class) and optimized image delivery (next/image).
Reservation Inquiry System: Multi-step or clean validated booking form capturing pickup/drop-off locations, dates/times, passenger count, and vehicle choice.
Performance & SEO: Semantic markup, dynamic OpenGraph/meta tags, and a target 90+ score on Google Lighthouse across mobile and desktop.
Responsiveness: Pixel-perfect adaptability across mobile, tablet, and wide screens.
2. Admin CMS & Lead Management Authentication: Secure admin authentication (credentials/session management).
Fleet & Content CRUD: Intuitive interface to add, edit, or delete fleet vehicles, pricing tiers/specs, and core site content.
Lead / Booking Viewer: Searchable, filterable table to track, review, and manage inbound booking inquiries.
Database: Structured relational schema managed via Prisma ORM (PostgreSQL or SQLite).
3. Production VPS Deployment & Handover Server Environment: Full production rollout on an Ubuntu Linux VPS.
Runtime & Proxy: Process management via PM2 (or Docker) behind an Nginx reverse proxy with gzip/brotli compression.
Security & SSL: Automated SSL via Let's Encrypt (Certbot) and basic firewall configuration (UFW).
Repository & Docs: Clean Git repository with documented environment variables (.env.example) and a straightforward README for maintenance.
Budget & Payment Milestone Contract Type: Fixed Price
